description: Submit one URL or a list of them to RSSAmp. A site URL works as well as a feed URL: the feed is discovered from the page. Anyone may submit; there is no account and no review queue. One URL resolves in the call and the answer carries its page; a list may be queued, and the answer says which. Rate limited per caller.

urls.description: Feed or site URLs. One is fine.

name: submit_feed
title: Add a feed to RSSAmp
